## Code Review

This pull request refactors the `cmd_create` function in `github-release-helper.sh` by decomposing it into three sub-functions—`_parse_create_args`, `_resolve_create_inputs`, and `_execute_release_create`—and introduces module-scoped variables for state management. The review feedback suggests moving the initialization of these variables from the parsing function to the `cmd_create` orchestrator to avoid side effects and ensure the command's state is reset predictably.

**Actionable comments posted: 1**
🧹 Nitpick comments (1)
.agents/scripts/github-release-helper.sh (1)
`182-200`: **Consider validating that flag arguments have values before `shift 2`.** If a user invokes `--repo` (or similar value-requiring flags) as the last argument without providing a value, `$2` will be unset. With `set -u` enabled, this produces a cryptic bash error rather than a helpful message.
🛡️ Optional: Add argument count check before consuming flag values ```diff --repo) + if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then + print_error "--repo requires a value" + return 1 + fi _create_flag_repo="$2" shift 2 ;; ``` Apply similar guards for `--tag`, `--title`, `--notes`, and `--notes-file` if desired.
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In @.agents/scripts/github-release-helper.sh around lines 182 - 200, When parsing flags like --repo, --tag, --title, --notes and --notes-file, ensure you validate that a value exists before assigning _create_flag_repo/_create_flag_tag/_create_flag_title/_create_flag_notes/_create_flag_notes_file from "$2" and doing shift 2; add a guard (e.g., check $# -lt 2 or test -z "${2-}" ) inside each corresponding case branch to print a clear error/usage message and exit 1 if the value is missing, and only then assign the variable and shift. ```
🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. Inline comments: In @.agents/scripts/github-release-helper.sh: - Around line 202-204: The parsed flag _create_flag_generate_notes is never consumed in _execute_release_create so an explicit --generate-notes is ignored; update _execute_release_create to check _create_flag_generate_notes and, when true, force the behavior that generates notes (e.g., set _create_generate_notes=true and unset/ignore _create_notes and _create_notesfile) so the explicit flag overrides provided notes, or alternatively remove the --generate-notes parsing branch if you intend to keep the current default-only behavior. Ensure you modify the logic that currently inspects _create_notes and _create_notesfile so it respects _create_flag_generate_notes. --- Nitpick comments: In @.agents/scripts/github-release-helper.sh: - Around line 182-200: When parsing flags like --repo, --tag, --title, --notes and --notes-file, ensure you validate that a value exists before assigning _create_flag_repo/_create_flag_tag/_create_flag_title/_create_flag_notes/_create_flag_notes_file from "$2" and doing shift 2; add a guard (e.g., check $# -lt 2 or test -z "${2-}" ) inside each corresponding case branch to print a clear error/usage message and exit 1 if the value is missing, and only then assign the variable and shift. ```
